defectsResolved.title: Strict project admission runs after transaction COMMIT
defectsResolved.rootCause: In scripts/import-canonical-projects-to-d1.mjs, COMMIT was executed prior to evaluating strict admission invariants. Furthermore, 0001_initial_schema.sql was being executed implicitly on write connection.
defectsResolved.resolution: Enclosed all database writes, post-write relational reconciliation, and strict admission evaluation inside ONE atomic SQLite transaction (BEGIN TRANSACTION ... COMMIT). Eliminated implicit schema execution; required preexisting schema with fail-closed check on 7 tables. Added negative test GATEB-27 proving that a failed strict run triggers ROLLBACK leaving exactly 0 rows, 0 revisions, and 0 publishing events committed.

defectsResolved.title: Media transfer scope declares images/projects/ but actual keys use projects/
defectsResolved.rootCause: scripts/generate-media-manifest-and-simulation.mjs declared r2NamespacePrefix: 'images/projects/' in transfer scope payload while canonical project keys were generated with 'projects/'.
defectsResolved.resolution: Updated CANONICAL_PROJECT_MEDIA r2NamespacePrefix to 'projects/'. Verified that 100% of 130 canonical project media keys match 'projects/' and 42 video media keys match 'videos/'.

defectsResolved.title: Project relational parity omits attributes and lacks revision/publishing history verification
defectsResolved.rootCause: compareCanonicalWithProjectRecord() omitted parent sort_order and source_url, checked only 5 of 14 media attributes, allowed extra category assignments, and lacked historical integrity assertions.
defectsResolved.resolution: Expanded compareCanonicalWithProjectRecord() to verify parent sort_order and source_url; all 14 media attributes (id, kind, media_type, storage_key, public_url, filename, mime_type, byte_size, width, height, alt_tr, alt_en, caption_tr, caption_en, sort_order) plus extra media detection; strict 1:1 category assignments; and historical integrity (initial seed revision 1 with action seed_migration, initial publishing event with event_type publish). Preserved subsequent owner audit history without false conflicts.

defectsResolved.title: Ownership validation allows arbitrary project namespaces and simulator plans missing local files
defectsResolved.rootCause: validateMediaAssetOwnership() did not require key.startsWith('projects/') for projects, and simulateMediaSync() planned uploads without gating on file.status === 'LOCAL_PRESENT' and non-null sha256.
defectsResolved.resolution: Enforced strict namespace boundaries in validateMediaAssetOwnership() rejecting non-canonical prefixes (images/projects/, misc/, uploads/, other/). Gated simulateMediaSync() on file.status === 'LOCAL_PRESENT' and verified sha256/byteSize, routing missing files to syncResults.rejectedMissingFiles.
